tools.name: assurance_prepare
tools.description: Use this when you, the buyer, chose a public service and want its delivery checked end to end. Pass `service_url`, `checks` and explicit_read_only_consent=true. GAIP preflights it and records your checks; returns a `terms_id` for assurance_complete. Free, no account; records a GAIP receipt only. Inp

tools.name: assurance_complete
tools.description: Use this when finishing a Buyer Assurance check. Pass the `terms_id` from assurance_prepare and mode PUBLIC_REPLAY (GAIP replays the service) or BUYER_SUBMITTED. Returns PASS / FAIL / UNKNOWN per check and a delivery receipt. Free, no account; records a GAIP receipt only. Inputs must be public and n

tools.name: assurance_verify
tools.description: Use this when you hold a Buyer Assurance terms or delivery receipt_id and want to confirm it. Returns the retained record and its integrity proof (integrity only). Free, read-only, no account; inputs must be public and non-personal.
